name: hare_apparent_a_rabbit_for_each_other_hare_you_control
notes: M3 mapper. Printed: 'When this creature enters, create a number of 1/1 white Rabbit creature tokens equal to the number of other creatures you control named Hare Apparent.' Seat 0 controls two Hare Apparents, the opponent one. A third Hare Apparent enters under seat 0: two Rabbits (the other two Hares seat 0 controls; the entering one and the opponent's do not count).
